item.title: Millions of pensioners and families miss out on £4,700 in DWP payments
item.body: Millions of pensioners and families are missing out on £4,700 in DWP payments. The scale of unclaimed support has been described as 'shocking'.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 💷 Millions of pensioners and families miss out on £4,700 in DWP payments

Millions of pensioners and families are missing out on £4,700 in DWP payments. The scale of unclaimed support has been described as 'shocking'.
